title: "I cried remembering them in the fog of the tear gas"
situation: After the 20 July tear gas, posts joke about pollution, fuel adulteration and exes.

lines.text: Delhi Police, please don't use tear gas. It pollutes the city.
lines.speaker: X post
lines.via: DT Next (agency copy, also in Outlook)

lines.text: Unlike petrol blended with E20, the tear gas used during the protest was 100 per cent authentic and without adulteration.
lines.speaker: X post

lines.text: I cried remembering them in the fog of the tear gas.
lines.speaker: Instagram post
lines.via: DT Next (agency copy, also in Outlook)

lines.text: I am totally safe here. There are a lot of police around me. Nobody can hit me.
lines.speaker: Instagram post
lines.via: DT Next (agency copy, also in Outlook)

lines.text: Even they didn't ignore me so much!

buildThis.situation: Feed and ticker barks after the gas: the in-game feed fills with these kinds of jokes while friends nearby are actually coughing.
